title: nav-fleet: operations
description: Health of fleet-gateway, fleet-control, mcp-registry and the MCP servers. Panels follow the alerts in .nais/app.yaml.

list.label: Metrics
list.name: DS_METRICS
list.description: Mimir data source with X-Scope-OrgID tenant. This dashboard belongs in the Grafana that reads the tenant org.

list.label: Logs
list.name: DS_LOGS
list.description: Loki data source with X-Scope-OrgID tenant. This dashboard belongs in the Grafana that reads the tenant org.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: MCP requests through the gateway.

panels.title: 5xx rate
panels.description: Red above 10 %, like the alert FleetGatewayHigh5xxRate. Deliberate 503s with a reason are not counted. The alert also needs more than 20 requests in 5 min, so a few requests at night can turn this red without an alert. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(fleet_gateway_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", code=~"5..", reason=""}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(fleet_gateway_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env"}[5m]))

panels.title: Failed MCP calls/s
panels.description: Every outcome except ok, unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied, so upstream_<code> and upstream_error are included. This is broader than the SLO in #2972. The SLO counts as errors only store_error, upstream_token_error, over_capacity, sse_over_capacity, user_cap and user_sse_cap, and excludes unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied from the total.

panels.title: Latency p95 incl. SSE
panels.description: No latency alert; shown for trend. Includes SSE streams, which count until they close, and fast 401s. Shown as p95 incl. SSE until the gateway has an SSE label.

panels.title: Worst route error ratio (5 min)
panels.description: Highest 5-minute error ratio of any route, from the recording rule the SLO alerts use (#2972). Orange from 3 % and red from 7.2 %, the slow and fast burn thresholds for the 99.5 % target. Errors follow the SLO in #2972: gateway faults count as bad (store_error, upstream_token_error, over_capacity, sse_over_capacity, user_cap, user_sse_cap); unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied are left out of the total; upstream_<code> and upstream_error are not counted as bad. Target 99.5 % availability per route per month. The latency SLO (p95 below 1 s, SSE excluded) has no panel until #2973 adds an SSE label.

panels.title: Available replicas
panels.description: Same metric as the alert FleetGatewayNoReadyPods. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Availability (1 d) by route
panels.description: Share of counted MCP calls that succeeded over the last day, per route. Red below 97 %: an error ratio of 3 %, which is 6x burn, the slow alert's threshold on its own 1 d window. The fast alert (14.4x) uses 5 min and 1 h windows; see the fast burn panel. A route with fewer than 20 counted calls in a day shows no tile: too little traffic to judge. Errors follow the SLO in #2972: gateway faults count as bad (store_error, upstream_token_error, over_capacity, sse_over_capacity, user_cap, user_sse_cap); unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied are left out of the total; upstream_<code> and upstream_error are not counted as bad. Target 99.5 % availability per route per month. The latency SLO (p95 below 1 s, SSE excluded) has no panel until #2973 adds an SSE label.

targets.expr: (1 - (fleet_gateway:slo_availability_errors:ratio_rate1d{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"} >= 0)) and on (namespace, k8s_cluster_name, route) (fleet_gateway:slo_availability_requests:increase1d{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"} >= 20)

panels.title: 5xx rate (1 d), gateway-wide
panels.description: Gateway-wide 5xx share over the last day from the recording rule (no route label, so it does not follow the route filter). Target below 1 %; red from 1 %. The rule needs at least 20 responses a day, so dev and quiet days show too little traffic.

panels.title: Fast burn (5 min and 1 h)
panels.description: Error ratio divided by the error budget (0.5 %), over the two windows FleetGatewayAvailabilityBurnFast uses. It fires when both are above 14.4x (dashed line). Errors follow the SLO in #2972: gateway faults count as bad (store_error, upstream_token_error, over_capacity, sse_over_capacity, user_cap, user_sse_cap); unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied are left out of the total; upstream_<code> and upstream_error are not counted as bad. Target 99.5 % availability per route per month. The latency SLO (p95 below 1 s, SSE excluded) has no panel until #2973 adds an SSE label.

panels.title: Slow burn (6 h and 1 d)
panels.description: Error ratio divided by the error budget (0.5 %), over the two windows FleetGatewayAvailabilityBurnSlow uses. It fires when both are above 6x (dashed line). Errors follow the SLO in #2972: gateway faults count as bad (store_error, upstream_token_error, over_capacity, sse_over_capacity, user_cap, user_sse_cap); unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied are left out of the total; upstream_<code> and upstream_error are not counted as bad. Target 99.5 % availability per route per month. The latency SLO (p95 below 1 s, SSE excluded) has no panel until #2973 adds an SSE label.

panels.title: Counted requests (1 d) by route
panels.description: Calls the availability SLO counts, over a sliding day. Below the dashed line at 20 the SLO tiles and alerts have too little traffic to judge.

panels.title: Load shedding (5 min)
panels.description: 503s from shedding. The value is the count over the alert's own window (5 min), last value, with the alert threshold. The sparkline shows the history. Red above 5 (SustainedShedding). Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Rate limited (5 min)
panels.description: 429s. The value is the count over the alert's own window (5 min), last value, with the alert threshold. The sparkline shows the history. Red above 20 (SustainedRateLimiting). Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Upstream token errors (10 min)
panels.description: The value is the count over the alert's own window (10 min), last value, with the alert threshold. The sparkline shows the history. Red above 5 (UpstreamTokenErrors).

panels.title: Failed MCP calls (5 min)
panels.description: Every outcome except ok, unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied, so upstream_<code> and upstream_error are included. This is broader than the SLO in #2972. The SLO counts as errors only store_error, upstream_token_error, over_capacity, sse_over_capacity, user_cap and user_sse_cap, and excludes unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied from the total.

panels.title: Route sync failures (15 min)
panels.description: Count over the last 15 min, last value. No alert; amber from 1. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Never synced pods
panels.description: Gateway pods that read routes from fleet-control and have no successful sync yet, like the alert FleetGatewayRouteNeverSynced. Pods that read routes from git are not counted. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

targets.expr: count(fleet_gateway_routes_loaded{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env"} * on (pod, k8s_cluster_name) group_left fleet_gateway_routes_source_info{namespace="$namespace", source="fleet-control"} unless on (pod, k8s_cluster_name) fleet_gateway_route_snapshot_age_seconds{namespace="$namespace"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Routes disabled (kill switch)
panels.description: Routes that answered with outcome=disabled (503 reason=disabled) in the last 5 min: the kill switch is on. Not a fault.

targets.expr: count(sum by (route) (increase(fleet_gateway_mcp_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route", outcome="disabled"}[5m])) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Container restarts (15 min)
panels.description: The value is the count over the alert's own window (15 min), last value, with the alert threshold. The sparkline shows the history. Red above 2 (PodRestarts). Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: 5xx rate (excluding deliberate rejections)
panels.description: Same expression as the alert FleetGatewayHigh5xxRate: 5xx without a reason label. Alerts above 10 %. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: 5xx by status code
panels.description: 5xx responses the alert counts (no reason label), by status code. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Failed MCP calls by route and outcome
panels.description: Every outcome except ok, unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied, so upstream_<code> and upstream_error are included. This is broader than the SLO in #2972. The SLO counts as errors only store_error, upstream_token_error, over_capacity, sse_over_capacity, user_cap and user_sse_cap, and excludes unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied from the total.

panels.title: Available vs desired replicas
panels.description: Alert NoReadyPods fires when a deployment has 0 available replicas. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Load shedding by reason
panels.description: 503 with a reason: cap, user_cap, user_sse_cap, store_full, refresh_in_flight, disabled. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Rate limited by endpoint
panels.description: Rejected calls (429) by OAuth endpoint. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Upstream token errors
panels.description: Alert UpstreamTokenErrors: more than 5 in 10 min.

panels.title: Route sync failures
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Alert PodRestarts: more than 2 restarts in 15 min. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Route snapshot age (fleet-gateway)
panels.description: Age of each pod's route snapshot. The alert FleetGatewayRouteSnapshotStale fires above 600 s. Pods that never synced are missing here: see Never synced pods. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: fleet-gateway errors and warnings
panels.description: Error and warning lines from fleet-gateway (tenant Loki). Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Routes loaded
panels.description: Routes the gateway has loaded from its configuration. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: Calls to the MCP gateway by route.

panels.title: Requests by outcome (in the SLO total)
panels.description: Outcomes in the SLO total: everything except unauthorized, disabled and tool_denied. Of these, only store_error, upstream_token_error, over_capacity, sse_over_capacity, user_cap and user_sse_cap are SLO errors (#2972); ok, upstream_<code> and upstream_error are not. Excluded outcomes are in the next panel.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (route, le) (rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (route) sum by (route) (rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (route) sum by (route) (rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 by route incl. SSE
panels.description: MCP call duration by route. Includes SSE streams, which count until they close, and fast 401s. Shown as p95 incl. SSE until the gateway has an SSE label.

panels.title: Routes from stored snapshot
panels.description: 1 means the pod started from a stored snapshot because fleet-control did not answer. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Pending audit events (lockout outbox)
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Excluded outcomes (not failures)
panels.description: unauthorized (OAuth handshake 401), disabled (kill switch) and tool_denied. The SLO leaves these out.

panels.title: HTTP requests by path
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (path, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app="mcp-registry"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: HTTP latency p95 by path
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(mcp_tool_calls_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app="mcp-onboarding", status="error"}[1h])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(mcp_tool_calls_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app="mcp-onboarding"}[1h]))

panels.title: Tool call error rate (1 h)
panels.description: mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,status} only exists after the first tool call since the pod started, and status="error" only after a failed call. An empty graph means no calls in range, not missing data. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Up by MCP server
panels.description: Scrape target health for the MCP servers. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: OAuth flow by stage
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: OAuth callback by result
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Tool calls: success vs error
panels.description: mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,status} only exists after the first tool call since the pod started, and status="error" only after a failed call. An empty graph means no calls in range, not missing data. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: HTTP requests by path
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: HTTP latency p95 by path
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Tool calls by server and tool
panels.description: mcp-kodeverk, mcp-team-catalog and mcp-dolly, from lib/mcpkit. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

targets.expr: sum by (app) (rate(mcp_tool_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app=~"mcp-kodeverk|mcp-team-catalog|mcp-dolly"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (app) (rate(mcp_tool_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app=~"mcp-kodeverk|mcp-team-catalog|mcp-dolly"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tool call error rate by server
panels.description: Failed calls divided by all calls. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Latency p95 by server
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: HTTP requests by status code
panels.description: Alert High5xxRate for fleet-control. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: HTTP latency p95
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Errors: database, audit, notify
panels.description: Alert DBErrors: more than 5 database errors in 10 min. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Console lookups: total and failed
panels.description: Alert ConsoleLookupsFailing: 3 or more failed lookups in 10 min. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Last successful snapshot age
panels.description: Alert SnapshotStale above 600 s. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Snapshot build time p95
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Snapshot size
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

targets.expr: sum by (service_name, msg) (count_over_time({service_namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", service_name=~"fleet-gateway|fleet-control"} |= "audit" | json | msg=~"audit .*" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Audit events by service
panels.description: From the stdout log (tenant Loki). Shows volume, not content. Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

targets.expr: sum by (container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", container=~"fleet-gateway|fleet-control|mcp-registry|mcp-onboarding|mcp-dolly|mcp-kodeverk|mcp-team-catalog"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", container=~"fleet-gateway|fleet-control|mcp-registry|mcp-onboarding|mcp-dolly|mcp-kodeverk|mcp-team-catalog", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: CPU vs request
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).

panels.title: Memory (working set)
panels.description: Does not follow the route filter (no route label).
